findings.title: v14's eighth acceptance-test class (AT-8, the seventeen unrideable AT-ARCHIVE-* keys) is absent from the specification, and the clean-cell pass condition is therefore satisfiable by a conformance report v14 itself declares report-invalid
findings.propositionRefuted: That this specification consumes the AT/CI/LV class supply of the pinned component-packaging-contract.v14 and states a pass condition sufficient for a valid v14 conformance report.

evidenceFromPinnedBytes.v14ClassCount: component-packaging-contract.v14.json acceptanceTests.classes contains EIGHT classes: AT-1 clean install, AT-2 no ambient dependencies, AT-3 hostile paths, AT-4 health/subprotocol negotiation, AT-5 offline/air-gap use, AT-6 update/rollback, AT-7 size/quality/performance gates, AT-8 archive profile byte identity and negatives.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.at8RequiresVerbatim: Every archiveProfile.byteAlgorithm.goldenAndNegativeCases member. Two adapters, same pins, same archiveDigest. Body/target/extra/missing/typeflag/checksum negatives refuse. 100-byte name/link ACCEPT; 101-byte name/link typed profile-capacity non-success.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.v14ReportRuleVerbatim: AT-* halves and AT-ARCHIVE-* keys are required members of this array. There is no aggregate AT-8 map key; AT-8 the acceptance-test class is the set of AT-ARCHIVE-* members.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.v14ReportInvalidRuleVerbatim: Class-wide stand-ins, missing keys, duplicate keys, or alternative producers are report-invalid.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.v14LawfulExemptionsVerbatim: not-applicable and blocked-on-ride are lawful only via the ride recorded on that memberKey. An unrelated ID-DEP-* or OD-* does not exempt a member. Missing, duplicate, or unrelated rides are report-invalid.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.mapArithmetic: conformanceReport.fixtureMemberMap: mapKeyCount 80, acceptanceTestKeyCount 10, archiveGoldenKeyCount 17. Enumerated from the members object: 10 AT-<n> half keys and 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, disjoint categories.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.ridesEnumerated: All 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* members carry NO ride field. Producers are S-3-EMIT (4), fixtureGenerator (11), behavioral-harness (2). By v14's lawfulExemptions rule, with no ride recorded on the memberKey the ONLY lawful standing for each of the 17 is 'produced' with evidence {path, sha256}. There is no lawful not-applicable or blocked-on-ride path for any of them.
evidenceFromPinnedBytes.subjectOccurrenceCounts: In the 17911 subject bytes: 'AT-8' appears 0 times, 'AT-ARCHIVE' 0 times, 'goldenAndNegativeCases' 0 times. The class appears in no matrixCells[*].activeClasses, no inactiveOrBlocked sentence, no retainedEvidence entry, no failsIf line, and no doesNotExecute line.

whereTheScopingHappens: basedOn.packagingV14.role: 'Supplies AT-1..AT-7, hermeticCI CI-1..CI-5, localDeveloperValidation LV-1..LV-4, and conformanceReport shape... This specification consumes those AT/CI/LV classes'. v14 supplies eight AT classes; the consumed set is scoped to seven.
executesWhenRun: 'The 51 authored exact-byte fixtures recorded at D-106, plus the AT-1..AT-7 / CI / LV classes specified above.' The executed set is again scoped to seven.

matrixCells.clean.passProperty: 'whose fixtureClassCoverage includes every AT-* half required by v14'. The generic phrase 'every AT-* half' does correctly reach all ten AT-<n> half keys, including AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL and AT-4-NEGOTIATION. It does NOT reach the 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, because v14 states them as a SEPARATE required category ('AT-* halves AND AT-ARCHIVE-* keys') and states 'There is no aggregate AT-8 map key'.
findings.operativeBite: A run of this harness can satisfy the clean-cell passProperty as written while emitting a fixtureClassCoverage array missing all 17 AT-ARCHIVE-* keys. v14 calls that array report-invalid on missing keys. The specification's pass condition therefore admits a conformance report that the contract it pins rejects. This is a spec-conflicts-pinned-source defect, not only an enumeration gap.
findings.whyThisClassAndNotAnother: AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY (producer 'behavioral-harness', no ride) requires verbatim: 'AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY: two adapter runs with identical CI-1/CI-5 pins emit identical archive bytes and archiveDigest'. The live DR-G15 claim is verbatim: 'Different language build adapters emit the same verifiable OpenSIP component contract'. The omitted class's identity case is the byte-identity property the gate itself asserts. The specification retains archiveDigest and checks archiveProfileId equals opensip-archive-profile.1 (EV-1 exactByteIntent, EV-7 passProperty), but retaining one emission's digest and checking a profile identifier is not the two-run byte-identity test, and covers none of the eleven refusal negatives or the 100/101 name/link boundary cases.
findings.singleAdapterObjectionPreempted: The AT-8 class prose says 'Two adapters, same pins, same archiveDigest', which might be read as out of scope for a TypeScript-only slice-1 matrix. That reading does not rescue the subject. The REQUIRED map member is AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY, whose requireVerbatim says 'two adapter RUNS', i.e. single-adapter determinism, fully executable under this specification's slice-1 matrix. And even under the stricter class-level reading, the 17 keys carry no ride, so omission remains unlawful under v14 rather than exempt.
findings.proofThisIsOmissionNotDeliberateScoping: The subject demonstrably knows how to declare a class it does not activate, and does so for every other non-produced half: AT-1-TRUSTED-INSTALL (clean cell inactiveOrBlocked, ride DR-112/ID-DEP-P3), AT-5-TRUSTED-INSTALL (offline cell, DR-112/DR-110), AT-6 (upgrade cell inactiveOrBlocked naming ID-DEP-P3, plus an EV-5 measures entry, plus the failsIf line 'AT-6 is reported as a performed rollback or updateData is emitted'). Each of those three carries a ride in v14's map that licenses non-production. AT-8 alone receives zero bytes, and it is the one class with no ride to license its absence.
findings.remedyShape: State AT-8 explicitly. Because none of the 17 keys carries a ride, the honest options are to name the AT-ARCHIVE-* set as active on the cell(s) where the adapter emits an archive with an exactByteIntent for the golden and negative cases, or to record the class as leftover-design with a named obligation and an owner on DR-103 alongside OBL-WINDOWS-PATH / OBL-ENVELOPE-MISMATCH / OBL-UNICODE-NORM. What is not available is silence, and not available is a pass condition worded so the keys are optional. This reviewer authors neither the fixtures nor the obligation text.
findings.notCharged: AT-4-NEGOTIATION. It is absent as a literal string, but it IS an AT-* half, so the clean-cell phrase 'every AT-* half required by v14' reaches it, and the failsIf line 'health standing is omitted without an AT-4 / ID-DEP-P4 ride' quotes v14's own healthAndSubprotocol ride string verbatim. No finding.

decision.summary: v2 lands the v1 finding cleanly and passes every mechanical and prohibition check. It fails on one substantive defect: v14 supplies eight acceptance-test classes and v2 consumes seven. The eighth, AT-8, is the set of seventeen AT-ARCHIVE-* keys, none of which carries a ride, so none can lawfully stand as not-applicable or blocked-on-ride. The specification names them nowhere, and its clean-cell pass condition asks only for 'every AT-* half', a phrase v14's own two-category wording excludes them from. A conformance report meeting the stated pass condition can therefore be report-invalid under the pinned contract. The omitted class's identity case is the two-run archive byte-identity property that is DR-G15's own claim.
